problem.title: Volute liner wear-through on tailings pump P-4120
problem.site: Iron ore beneficiation plant, Pilbara WA
problem.whatHappened: The volute liner of P-4120 wore through at the cutwater on 9 May 2026 and slurry sprayed from the casing split. The pump tripped on low discharge pressure after 4,100 hours on this liner. Standby P-4121 was out of service with its impeller removed, so the plant ran on a bypass at reduced tails rate for 3 days until a liner arrived.
problem.where: Cutwater area of the volute liner on P-4120.
problem.when: Pump in normal duty on VSD. Noticed rougher sound for about a week before the trip.
problem.impact: Plant at about 60% feed for 72 hours, about 30 hours of lost production. Slurry spray onto the pad, clean-up by vacuum truck. No injury.
problem.makeModel: Hard-metal lined 6/4 slurry pump, 90 kW VSD
problem.duty: Tailings transfer from thickener to storage facility, duty/standby

evidence.title: Run hours and liner change history, last four sets
evidence.note: Liner lives 4,600, 4,450, 4,300 and 4,100 h. Current set ran 4,100 h.

evidence.title: Wear-through at the cutwater
evidence.note: Hole about 40 mm at the cutwater. Even wear pattern, no gouging or cavitation pitting seen. Liner hardness not measured.

evidence.title: Tailings density and sizing log
evidence.note: Density 1.38 to 1.42 t/m3 steady across the period. Sieve P80 about 150 microns, same as last year.

evidence.title: Work order for standby P-4121
evidence.note: WO raised 22 Apr for impeller wear. Part on order, 6 week lead time. Still open on 9 May.

evidence.title: Store stock list
evidence.note: No spare volute liner for the 6/4 pump on hand. One impeller on hand. No min/max set for liners.

evidence.title: Operator
evidence.note: Pump sounded rougher for about a week. Not logged. No casing thickness checks are done on any slurry pump.
